title: Normal-Cone Is All You Need: Unsoftened Fulton-MacPherson Symplectic Integration of the 3D Newtonian N-Body Problem — Companion Lean 4 Formal Proofs, Dual-Precision Python Software & Benchmark Datasets (v1.0.0)
description:
Companion archival repository for the monograph Normal-Cone Is All You Need: Unsoftened Fulton–MacPherson Symplectic Integration of the 3D Newtonian N-Body Problem (v1.0.0). This archive contains three certified pillars:

  1. Lean 4 + Mathlib 4 Formal Verification Suite (lean4/, Appendix A §A.1–§A.20): 35 formal modules and 5 self-contained chapter compilation suites (416 formal declarations, 214 theorems, 99 explicit #print axioms checks, 0 sorryAx) certifying the Darboux 2-form, the 10-generator Galilean–Bargmann Lie–Poisson algebra, the deformation to the normal cone, the Heavy Top Casimirs, the synodic PCR3BP and Levi-Civita covering, the Fulton–MacPherson hierarchy Q[N], the universal C^{1,1} screened apex bounds, the synchronous super-node anti-Zeno scaling, the palindromic splitting hierarchy (S2, Suzuki S4, BM4, BM6, PBM4), the non-commutative inter-chart gauge connection T_{A->B}^{(PBM4)}, and the bidegree-(3,2) Hall Lie algebra L(5,2) universal sixth-order obstruction theorem.
  2. Dual-Precision Symplectic N-Body Engines (normal_cone_nbody_float64/ & normal_cone_nbody_float128/, Appendix A §A.21): 1-to-1 mirrored production libraries in hardware IEEE-754 Float64 (46 modules, Numba @njit) and 116-bit / 35-digit quadruple-precision Float128 (46 modules), together with the 7 standalone Appendix A reference interfaces (interfaces/) and 330 automated unit tests (tests/).
  3. Reproducible Benchmark Campaigns & Certified JSON Datasets (benchmarks/, figures/, results/campaigns/, scripts/): 8 benchmark generators (Chapters 6 & 7, including head-to-head confrontations against REBOUND 5.2.2 WHFast, MERCURIUS, TRACE, and IAS15 across protocols B1, B2, and B4), 14 certified JSON datasets, and 8 publication figure plotters (300 DPI PDF/PNG).
